result: Added e2e/test_doctor.py with 3 scripted e2e tests for `tether doctor`: (1) against the proxy with OLLAMA_HOST set to chaos.url, exit 0 and `ok` lines for ollama and model; (2) against a closed localhost port, exit 1 and a FAIL line naming OLLAMA_HOST; (3) with an unpulled model name, exit 1, ollama ok, model FAIL, and the `ollama pull <name>` hint. Verified: `TETHER_E2E=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest e2e/test_doctor.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` gives 3 passed; `ruff check e2e` and `ruff format --check e2e` both pass. No other files were changed.
